_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for business details. Edit here, then run: python3 tools/build.py

business.name: Pellikal Window Enhancements
business.serviceArea: Long Island · Nassau · Suffolk · Queens · Brooklyn · Manhattan · NYC
business._googleReviewsUrlNote: SET 7 Oct 2026 (v30): the PUBLIC Google Maps listing of 'Pellikal Window Solutions' (maps/search?api=1 + query_place_id). It is the FIRST choice for every 'Read all reviews on Google' link and for the hero count, in fallback mode and live mode alike (then Google's synced mapsUri, then a placeId URL). PUBLIC URL ONLY - never the signed-in Business Profile management URL: nothing with authuser=, /customers/reviews or any other account-specific parameter; must start with https://. Any value starting with REPLACE_ is treated as unknown and NO link is shown - never invented. Change it here only, then run python3 tools/build.py: it is copied into every data-greviews-url attribute and every 'Read all reviews' href.

_analyticsComment: PRODUCTION Google IDs - FOUR ROLES, keep them straight: googleTagId AW-859941989 = the Google tag INSTALLED on the pages (unified tag); ga4MeasurementId G-J8SQ4CC7BT = the GA4 DESTINATION of that tag; gtmContainerId GTM-MK2PHWB = the container; googleAdsId AW-859941989 = the Ads account whose conversion fires inside GTM on generate_lead. tools/build.py stamps THREE generated pieces, in this order, into every tracked public page's <head>: (1) the Consent Mode v2 block (regional defaults + saved choice), (2) the Google tag (gtag.js loader + gtag('config', googleTagId)) - DIRECT since 7 Oct 2026, switched by ga4DirectTag, (3) the GTM container snippet. Google Ads conversions, the Conversion Linker, Microsoft Clarity and the GA4 custom-EVENT tag stay inside GTM. The GTM Google Tag 'GA4' (G-J8SQ4CC7BT) is PAUSED and stays paused - see docs/GA4-DIRECT-TAG.md.

analytics._googleTagIdNote: THE INSTALLED GOOGLE TAG ID (7 Oct 2026 correction). This account uses a unified Google tag: the Google Ads ID is the tag that is installed, and the GA4 web stream G-J8SQ4CC7BT is a connected DESTINATION of it. GA4 -> Data streams -> View tag instructions -> Install manually shows exactly this ID, and gtag/js?id=G-J8SQ4CC7BT answers 404 in this account. So the page loads gtag/js?id=<googleTagId> and calls gtag('config', <googleTagId>); that one tag sends the GA4 page_view to G-J8SQ4CC7BT and loads the Ads tag. It is NOT a conversion: the Ads conversion still fires only from GTM on generate_lead.
analytics._ga4MeasurementIdNote: The GA4 Analytics DESTINATION / Measurement ID. Never used as a loader ID on the pages (see _googleTagIdNote); referenced by the GTM tag 'GA4 - Pellikal Custom Events' and in the privacy policy.
analytics._ga4DirectNote: true = build.py emits Google's gtag.js loader + gtag('config', googleTagId) on every tracked page, AFTER the consent block (so the regional defaults and any saved Accept/Reject are already queued) and BEFORE the GTM snippet. The page's own gtag() is reused; no second dataLayer, no second consent implementation. The GA4 stream G-J8SQ4CC7BT receives its page_view as a destination of that tag. GTM STATE THAT GOES WITH true: the GTM Google Tag 'GA4' (G-J8SQ4CC7BT, Initialization - All Pages) stays PAUSED; do not add another Google base tag in GTM. ROLLBACK: set false, run python3 tools/build.py (the loader + config disappear from every page), publish, then un-pause that GTM tag. Never run both at once.
analytics._idNote: GTM is the only CONTAINER on the pages. The only Google tag LOADED by the pages is googleTagId (one gtag.js per page, generated by build.py). No conversion label and no gtag('event', 'conversion', ...) may ever appear in page code - the Ads conversion is configured INSIDE the GTM container only. Do not add a second gtag.js loader anywhere.
analytics._retiredGa4: G-TPD5SKWWVC - WRONG/OLD property. Must not be used anywhere.
analytics._consentComment: Google Consent Mode v2. build.py stamps these values into the consent block at the top of every tracked page's <head>, ABOVE the GTM snippet, and publishes them to js/consent.js as window.PELLIKAL_CONSENT_SETTINGS. DEFAULTS ARE REGIONAL since 28 Sep 2026 (Pellikal's configured behaviour, not a legal conclusion): every optional category is denied by default for visitors Google places in regionalDefaults.deniedRegions, and set to regionalDefaults.elsewhere for everyone else. Google resolves the region from the request - the pages do no geolocation. A stored Accept/Reject choice always overrides either default and is re-applied in the same head block before gtm.js. See docs/CONSENT-MODE.md.

regionalDefaults.deniedRegionsLabel: the EEA, the UK and Switzerland

consent._regionalNote: deniedRegions: ISO 3166-2 codes (2-letter country, or COUNTRY-SUBDIVISION such as US-CA) whose visitors get all four optional categories DENIED until they choose - the 27 EU states + Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway (= EEA), plus GB and CH. elsewhere: 'granted' or 'denied' - the default for every visitor NOT in deniedRegions. deniedRegionsLabel: the plain-English name of the list, shown in the banner and the preferences dialog - keep it in step with the list. The build refuses an empty deniedRegions while elsewhere is 'granted'. Nothing here clears stored choices: keep 'version' as it is unless you WANT to re-ask everyone.
consent._versionNote: v2 = granular Analytics/Advertising categories (14 Sep 2026); every v1 all/necessary choice was invalidated and visitors re-asked. Bump again only if what you measure materially changes. Stored format: VERSION:a0|a1:d0|d1:DATE.
consent._redactionNote: true = while ad_storage is denied, Google Ads redacts ad-click identifiers in its cookieless pings. Turned off automatically once a visitor accepts.
consent._nameNote: Letters, digits, _ and - only. The build fails on anything else.

_navComment: Order here = order in the menu. 'slug' is the folder name; home is "".
_footerComment: Links shown in the footer columns.
_formsComment: THE quote form, defined once. build.py renders partials/quote-form.html into every <!-- @partial:quote-form:VARIANT --> region, so /, /contact/, /residential/, /commercial/ and /window-inserts/ share one piece of markup and one submission path. Since 25 Sep 2026 every form asks the same four things (full name, phone, email, ZIP code) - the variants only differ in the hidden fields below. The Formspree endpoint is NOT duplicated here - build.py reads it out of js/config.js, which stays the single place it lives.

forms._successNote: Where a CONFIRMED successful Formspree response sends the visitor. build.py turns this into the correct relative link for each page's depth. The Google Ads conversion fires on the generate_lead event before the redirect; this page is the visitor's confirmation, not a second conversion.
forms._serviceNote: The FIXED VOCABULARY of the hidden service field - there is no dropdown any more (25 Sep 2026). Every variant's fixed service must be one of these (the build checks), and /contact/?service=... can only ever resolve to one of these labels (js/main.js matches by slug and copies OUR label, never the URL text). 'Commercial Window Film' was added 25 Sep so ?service=commercial resolves too. Order is for readability only.
forms._variantNote: One layout for every variant: full name (required), phone OR email (one of the two, checked in js/main.js), ZIP code (optional; 5 digits if given - reviewer's call, get the lead first and qualify on the call). service + property type travel as hidden fields; leave service blank (contact, homepage) and the form accepts ?service=<slug> from the URL. formLocation is the non-PII parameter that tells the forms apart in GA4; the homepage variant fires homepage_form_submit, every other one contact_form_submit. formVariant is only for the Formspree email.

_windowInsertsComment: Manufacturer performance claims for /window-inserts/ (the three stats cards; the tested-dBA band was removed 15 Sep at the owner's request - no exact decibel figures on the page). ENABLED 15 Sep 2026 at the owner's request for a real decibel figure. The figures are Indow's, for its Acoustic Grade product, and are attributed to Indow on the page. If the product sold is NOT Indow Acoustic Grade, set enabled:false and rebuild - one line. enabled=false renders qualitative cards and no band. The wording is fixed in tools/build.py -> insert_claims(); the figures are the manufacturer's own published numbers and are attributed to it, never stated as a Pellikal guarantee.
_reviewsComment: Google reviews (docs/GOOGLE-REVIEWS.md). The site shows the LIVE rating/count/reviews synced into Supabase. 'fallback' is a ONE-TIME BOOTSTRAP for the hero trust line only, for the period before Google approves API access: the values were read from the verified public Google Business Profile ('Pellikal Window Solutions') on 7 Oct 2026. js/reviews.js uses them ONLY when Supabase answers that no successful sync exists yet (no last_synced_at, or the table not created). The moment google_review_summary holds a successful sync, live data wins and the fallback is never used again - it cannot overwrite anything (the site never writes). 'fallback.reviews' (added later the same day) holds three verified review cards for the same waiting period - see _reviewsNote. Everything rendered from the fallback is marked data-greviews-source="fallback" (live data: "live"); the two are never mixed. REMOVE after the first successful sync: set rating and count to null and rebuild (build.py stamps the values into data-greviews-fallback-* on the hero proof elements).

fallback.source: Verified public Google Business Profile snapshot, 7 Oct 2026 - temporary bootstrap; remove after the first successful API sync

reviews.review_text: Really great service and installation of the privacy film. I live in a first floor condo in Brooklyn and I needed a way to prevent people from seeing inside. This was the best combination of privacy, energy efficiency, and UV rejection. Thank you!

Bart is a true professional and a pleasure to work with. He is reliable, knowledgeable and very reasonable. His heat reflecting film is a game changer. It is a very effective solution for keeping the heat out, while allowing the natural light to filter in. I highly recommend Bart and his window film.

Great service from start to finish. Great communication, knowledgeable about the product. Great follow-through and thorough. I had 20 year old film on my windows that should have been changed 12 years again. Bert came in assessed the windows and what I wanted the film to achieve. Came in, stripped the old stuff, replaced it with new stuff. Cleaned up and was gone in record time. You wouldn't know he was here except the sun no longer blinds me when in the room. Thank you for your excellence service.

fallback._reviewsNote: Three REAL reviews copied by hand from the Pellikal Window Solutions Google Business Profile on 7 Oct 2026, in the order chosen for usefulness. Text is verbatim - spelling, grammar and all - and must never be edited here (the QA suite compares what renders against these strings). Shown ONLY while Supabase reports that no successful sync exists; labelled 'Featured Google Reviews' (not 'most recent'); replaced entirely by the live reviews after the first successful sync, never mixed with them, never written to Supabase. Set to [] (and rating/count to null) after the first successful sync, then rebuild.

_syncOnlyComment: Files with no header/footer, but which still contain the phone/email and must stay in sync.
_pagesComment: Every page on the site. 'redirect: true' also creates the old .html forwarder at the root.

pages._note: Lead-confirmation page. Keeps the page's own GA4 Google tag (a page view, nothing more) and the GTM container (Conversion Linker, Ads); the Ads lead conversion fires on generate_lead before the redirect, NOT on this page view. Kept out of the sitemap and marked noindex because it is a confirmation screen, not SEO content. Deliberately NOT disallowed in robots.txt - blocking the crawl would stop Google ever seeing the noindex. redirect:false because the exact address is /thankyou/ with no .html forwarder.
